I have already performed a preliminary scan of the 'AI Baby' niche and identified 3 specific keyword clusters where your app is currently missing out on approximately 20% of potential organic traffic. You: Sure, here is the consolidated proposal detailing the workflow, cost, and timeline. 1. Technical Approach (How I will build it) I will build a custom Python application utilizing 3 core modules: Access & Scraping (Playwright): I will use Playwright (instead of basic Selenium) because Drouot.com is a modern dynamic site. Playwright allows for secure, reliable automated login and creates a 'browser context' that mimics a real user, preventing bans. Data Extraction & Filtering: The script will scan standard listings + your monitored keywords. It will extract high-res images, descriptions, and estimates into a structured JSON format. AI Integration (OpenAI API): The extracted data is sent to GPT-4o (via your API Key). I will design a System Prompt that acts as an 'Art Expert', analyzing the scraped data against the criteria you mentioned (undervalued assets, historical comparison). Reporting: The final output will be a daily PDF/HTML Dashboard delivered to you, highlighting only the "Interesting" opportunities. 2. Delivery & Installation (Zero-Hassle) The system is designed to run immediately on your machine without complex setup. I will provide a requirements.txt file. You run one single command to install dependencies. After that, you just click the script to run it. No manual driver installations or configuration needed. 3. Cost & Timeline Total Budget: $30.00 USD (Fixed Price) — I am keeping this competitive to build a long-term relationship with you. Lead Time: 3 Days. Day 1 (Tomorrow): Demo of the Scraping Engine (proving I can extract data from Drouot). Day 2-3: AI Integration & Reporting setup. Ready to start immediately.
